title: UFOs as homeostasis probes showing up at nuclear sites
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFOs as homeostasis probes showing up at nuclear sites, about an unknown time at nuclear sites, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: what we see in the form of UFOs is actually maybe just this earth regulating homeostasis kit where they show up at hinge points of civilization things like nuclear sites.

related.note: Both explain UFOs appearing at nuclear sites, but this telling makes them an Earth 'homeostasis kit' that appears at hinge points rather than watchers waiting for humanity to grow less violent.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on thinkers named Jacques Vallee and Steven Dick, floats the idea that UFOs might be part of the Earth's own "homeostasis kit", a self-balancing system that keeps the planet in check. In his telling they show up at turning points for civilization, such as nuclear sites, which would mean they act as a kind of planetary regulator rather than as visitors.
